description: Na₄Cd₃H₂(C₂O₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.80 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.59 Å. There are two inequivalent Cd sites. In the first Cd site, Cd is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing CdO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-66°. There are a spread of Cd-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.42 Å. In the second Cd site, Cd is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing CdO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-66°. There are a spread of Cd-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.32 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.35 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three equivalent Cd and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Cd and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cd, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Cd, and one C atom.
